lyrics: Charanam 2 -
anroru nAL indha vazhi vanda virundivarum ayarndu paDutturangum pOdhinilE-kaNNan
tinradu pOgak kaiyyil irunda vaNNaiyai anda virundhinar vAyil niraittu maraindhananE andha
nindai mighu pazhi ingE pAvamangE enrapaDi chintai migha nondiDavum seyya taghumO
nanda gOparkkindha vidam andha mighu piLLai pera nalla thavam seidAraDi enna sheivOmaDi
Charanam 3 -
veNNai veNNai tharum enrAn veNNai thandAl thinruviTTu peNNai thArum enru kETTu kaNNaDikkirAn
vaNamAi niruttham Adi maNNinaip padattAl Etrik kaNNIlE iraittu viTTu kaLavADinAn
paNNIshaiyum kuzhalUdinAn kETTU ninra paNBilE arugil vandu vambungaL sheidhAn
peNNinattukkenru vanda puNNiyangaL kOTIi kOTi eNNI unakkAghumaDi kaNNImaiyAip pOgudaDi
Charanam 4 -
ThottililE piLLai kiLLi vittathum avai alaRa - Vitta kaariyam agala veNNai thinRaan!
Kattina kanRai avizhththu ettiyum oLiththu vittu - Mattilaath thumbai kazhuththil maattik koNdaan!
Vittu vittu ammE enRaan kanRinaip pOlE - Attiyillaadha maadum ammaa enRathE!
Kittina kuvaLaiyOdum ettinaal un selva magan! - Pattiyil kaRavaiyidam paalai ootturaan adee!
Charanam 5 -
ChuRRi chuRRi ennai vanthu aththai veettu vazhi kEttaan - Siththaththukku ettum varaiyil solli ninREn
Aththudan vittaanO paarum aaththankarai vazhi kEttaan - Aththanaiyum sollivittu ninREn
Viththagamaai onRu kEttaan - naaNamaaguthE! - Muththaththukku vazhi kEttu saththam ittaaNdee
Aththanai idam koduththu meththavum vaLarththu vittaai! - Iththanai avanaich chollak kuththam illaiyeyadee!
Charanam 6 -
VeNNai veNNai thaarum enRaan! VeNNai thanthaal thinRu vittu - PeNNaith thaarum enRu kaNNadikkiraan!
VaNNamai niruththamaadi maNNinaip paathaththaal eRRik - KaNNilE iraiththu vittuk kaLavaadinaan!
PaNN isaiyum kuzhal oothinaan- kEttu ninRa - PaNbilE arugil vanthu vambugaL seithaan!
PeNNinaththukku enRu vantha puNNIyangaL kOdi kOdi - ENNi unakku aagumadi- kaNNIyaamaaip pOguthadee!

sections.title: Charanam 7
lyrics: mundhAnAL andhi nEratthil sondhamuDan kittE vandu - vindaigaL palavum sheidhu viLaiyADinAn (oru)
pandhaLavAgilum veNNai thandhAl viDuvEnenru - mundukilai thoTTizhutthu pOrADinAn
andha vAsudEvan ivan thAn aDi yashOdha - maindhanenat toTTizhuttu maDimEl vaitthu (avan)
sundhara mukhatthai kaNDu chinthaiyil mayangum nEram - anthara vaikuNTHamODu ellAm kATTinAn
